title: Return a greeting
summary: Laravel: Return a greeting. Change the message.
introduction: Route::get connects a URL to a function. Open GET /. Read the example, then check the result.

blocks.text: Create a practice Laravel project with Composer, then replace routes/web.php with one example. Start php artisan serve --host=127.0.0.1 --port=8000. These read-only starter routes need no database.

blocks.title: Return a greeting
blocks.code:
<?php
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Route;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
Route::get("/", fn () => "Hello, Asha!");

blocks.text: The GET facade registers a closure for /. Its returned string becomes the response.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Use routes/web.php for these unprefixed web routes.
